rationale: Screenreader focus remaining on a hidden BrowserWindow is directly accessibility, with BrowserWindow an appropriate secondary label. A Testcase Gist URL is supplied with a specific hide-on-close trigger and accessibility observations. 48268 is the closest same-behavior report but is already linked by the reporter; other retrieved focus or drag reports concern different triggers. This describes a shared Electron hide/accessibility path and offers a gist, so the references to shipping applications do not justify a third-party redirect.
